rv.q: It’s all the more brilliant for all of that – and it’s intriguing to speculate where Lee-Jones might turn her skewering eye next.
Jasmine Lee-Jones’ comedy about social media, racism and colourism crackles with energy.
This is a play of quicksilver skill, cool intellect and molten passion, and it's unmissable.
Lee-Jones's writing is genuinely hilarious, especially for audiences that are both 'extremely online' and well-versed in black Twitter.
Jones is a brilliant, dynamic writer, and this is a striking debut.

TL; DR: OMG, seven methods of killing kylie jenner is the must-see play of the summer. IMO, you should go see this show RN. (Please read, though. You’ll want to know more about this achingly powerful show.)
In short, this play is pure dynamite.

cn.t: Lee-Jones's incendiary debut about race, appropriation, and social media earns near-universal praise for its electric energy and formal innovation, though one critic objects to the provocative premise.
